# 自定义 Tab 点击操作 / Custom Tab Actions

<!-- binding:end -->

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 有些 Tab 点击后不应切换，而是执行一个操作：模态弹出发布页、打开菜单、启动相机、跳转到其他 App……以前只有 PlusButton 能这样做，普通 Tab 需要自己实现 `-tabBarController:shouldSelectViewController:` 并处理各种样式的差异。现在任意 Tab 都可以使用自定义点击操作：点击后不选中、不播放动画、不回调 `tabBarController:didSelectControl:`，而是执行你的操作。经典样式、液态玻璃与扁平样式都支持。 | Some tabs should run an action instead of being selected: present a publish page modally, open a menu, start the camera, open another app... Only the plus button could do that; a regular tab needed your own `-tabBarController:shouldSelectViewController:` and care for each style. Now any tab can run a custom action: a tap does not select it, does not animate and does not call `tabBarController:didSelectControl:`; your action runs instead. Works in the classic style, Liquid Glass and FlatDesign. |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    T["点击 Tab<br/>Tap a tab"] --> L{"需要登录且未登录？<br/>Needs login?"}
    L -- "是 / Yes" --> LOGIN["发起登录<br/>Start the login"]
    L -- "否 / No" --> H{"自定义操作？<br/>Custom action?"}
    H -- "否 / No" --> S["正常切换<br/>Select it"]
    H -- "是 / Yes" --> A["不切换，执行 cyl_customTabActionHandler / 代理<br/>No switch; run your action"]
```

## 用法 / Usage

```objc
// 1. 哪些 Tab 执行自定义操作：标识（CYLTabBarItemIdentifier）、block 或代理方法。
//    Which tabs run a custom action: identifiers (CYLTabBarItemIdentifier), a block, or the delegate method.
tabBarController.cyl_customActionTabBarItemIdentifiers = @[ @"publish" ];
// 或 / or:
tabBarController.cyl_shouldPerformCustomTabActionHandler = ^BOOL(CYLTabBarController *tabBarController, UIViewController *viewController) {
    return [viewController.cyl_tabBarItemIdentifier isEqualToString:@"publish"];
};

// 2. 执行自定义操作时执行的操作。/ The action.
tabBarController.cyl_customTabActionHandler = ^(CYLTabBarController *tabBarController, UIViewController *viewController) {
    UINavigationController *page = [[UINavigationController alloc] initWithRootViewController:[PublishViewController new]];
    [tabBarController presentViewController:page animated:YES completion:nil];
};
```

```swift
tabBarController.cyl_customActionTabBarItemIdentifiers = ["publish"]
tabBarController.cyl_customTabActionHandler = { tabBarController, viewController in
    tabBarController.present(UINavigationController(rootViewController: PublishViewController()), animated: true)
}
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 代理方式：实现 `-tabBarController:shouldPerformCustomActionForViewController:` 与 `-tabBarController:performCustomActionForViewController:`。block 优先于代理方法。 | Delegate: implement `-tabBarController:shouldPerformCustomActionForViewController:` and `-tabBarController:performCustomActionForViewController:`. Blocks take precedence. |
| 代理是 TabBarController 以外的对象时，请在其 `-tabBarController:shouldSelectViewController:` 开头调用：`if ([tabBarController cyl_performCustomTabActionIfNeededForViewController:viewController]) { return NO; }`。子类重写该方法时须调用 super。 | With a delegate that is not the tab bar controller itself, start its `-tabBarController:shouldSelectViewController:` with `if ([tabBarController cyl_performCustomTabActionIfNeededForViewController:viewController]) { return NO; }`. A subclass that overrides it must call super. |

## API

| API | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `cyl_customActionTabBarItemIdentifiers` | 使用自定义点击操作的 Tab 的标识列表。 | Identifiers of the custom action tabs. |
| `cyl_shouldPerformCustomTabActionHandler` | 是否执行自定义操作，优先于代理与标识。 | Whether to run the custom action; wins over the delegate and the identifiers. |
| `cyl_customTabActionHandler` | 执行自定义操作时执行的操作（每次点击一次）。 | The action (once per tap). |
| `-tabBarController:shouldPerformCustomActionForViewController:` / `-tabBarController:performCustomActionForViewController:` | 代理方式。 | The delegate versions. |
| `-cyl_isCustomActionTabViewController:` | 是否执行自定义操作（依次判断 block、代理、标识）。 | Whether it runs a custom action (block, delegate, identifiers). |
| `-cyl_performCustomTabActionIfNeededForViewController:` | 执行自定义操作时执行操作并返回 YES（应拒绝选中）。 | Runs the action and returns YES (refuse the selection) when it runs a custom action. |

## 限制 / Limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 代码选中（`selectedIndex = …`）不会执行自定义操作。 | Selecting in code (`selectedIndex = …`) does not run the custom action. |
| 需要登录的 Tab 先检查登录（见 [Login-Required-Tabs.md](Login-Required-Tabs.md)），登录后才检查自定义操作。 | A tab that needs login is checked for login first (see [Login-Required-Tabs.md](Login-Required-Tabs.md)), then for a custom action. |
| PlusButton 有自己的点击事件，不经过这里。 | The plus button has its own action and does not go through this. |
